resources.string: Your day, written down and easy to find.
Roudio works with your Plaud Note Pro. Here’s what it does:
Who said what, decisions and suggested tasks, each linked to the moment.
Backs everything up to your Drive
Recordings stay on this phone until you delete them.
Takes about 3 minutes. Keep your recorder nearby and charged.
One account does two jobs. It keeps your recordings yours, and it’s where backups go.
Only this account can see your recordings, here or on the web.
Backups in a Roudio folder on your Drive
Roudio only touches the folder it creates.
That account can’t open this Roudio
%1$s isn’t the owner. Pick the Google account this Roudio belongs to.
Couldn’t reach Roudio’s server. Check your connection and try again.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to reach your recorder.
Android will ask you for each one. Here’s why.
To find your recorder and pull recordings off it. Required.
Android shows one while transfers run. We also tell you when a backup needs you.
For faster transfers of long recordings. Optional.
Roudio never uses this phone’s microphone. Your recorder does the recording.
You can change these later in Settings.
Your phone stops apps in the background to save battery. Roudio needs to keep going with the screen off, or transfers stop.
Roudio starts again after a restart.
Settings › Apps › Manage apps › Roudio › Autostart
Your phone doesn’t tell apps this. Open the setting and switch Roudio on.
Settings › Apps › Roudio › Battery saver › No restrictions
Roudio can run with the screen off.
Optional. Open recent apps, hold Roudio, tap the lock.
Without it, transfers may stop when the screen is off. Phone updates can also switch these off; Settings will warn you.
Unlink it from the Plaud app
Your Note Pro works with one app at a time. If the Plaud app is linked to it, Roudio can’t connect.
Let the Plaud app finish syncing anything you want to keep from it.
Open the Plaud app and go to your Note Pro.
With the Note Pro next to your phone, choose the option to unlink or remove the device.
Come back here. You can keep the Plaud app installed.
